ordering: ABBA per dataset, fresh single-processor JVM per arm
scope: Original supplied manifests: 8 targets x 2 amounts x 3 stock profiles per dataset; full v3 graphs, not all producible targets. TB before/after comparison, not a new AW-solver comparison.
measurement: Planning call only; excludes input normalization, graph construction and independent replay. Allocation is cumulative bytes allocated by the planning thread, not peak or retained memory.
limitations: Two formal samples per query per version. Wall time and allocation can vary with JVM compilation; differences outside changed optimizer paths do not establish algorithmic causality. Missing or budget-cutoff results are not proofs of infeasibility.

profileCaveat: Separate 1-warmup/2-formal JFR runs over the same original 48-query manifests; JFR sample weights estimate allocation and are not exact byte counts. Formal ABBA timings and ThreadMXBean allocation exclude profiling.

complexity.feedbackComponents: One stable incidence index excludes unrelated patterns from each SCC; only 0/1 cyclic SCC bypasses the index. A pattern spanning multiple SCCs still requires classification in every touched SCC. No universal linear bound is claimed for such wide shared patterns.
complexity.feedbackJoin: For each consumed key, visit min(number of returned keys, number of indexed refill-input keys), then inspect actual matching refill edges; saturation and gcd formulas unchanged.
complexity.byproductSchedule: Keep one mutable adjacency map; SCC classification is completed before removing unsafe side edges. Ordinary item-to-item edges remain intact.
complexity.inputOrder: A linear scan skips grouping and graph construction only if no input key is a reachable byproduct or fixed replay item; returned, remainder and host-owned inputs retain the existing bypass.
